lenders.name: American Heritage Lending
lenders.footprint: National (state pages on site, e.g. Ohio, Michigan, Texas)
lenders.programs: Fix & flip, Ground-up construction, Bridge, DSCR rental, Bank statement, 1099, Foreign national, Asset qualifier, Jumbo
lenders.broker_program: Dedicated third-party origination (TPO) platform for mortgage brokers and correspondent lenders at ahlendtpo.com, separate from the direct-to-investor channel. Private Lender Link says the TPO platform offers DSCR, bank statement, 1099, foreign national, asset qualifier, bridge and jumbo programs, and that AHL lends on construction nationwide mainly through a large wholesale broker network. Broker fee caps not found.
lenders.fit_notes: California-headquartered wholesale lender (per Private Lender Link) with a real broker/TPO channel for fix & flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR take-outs on 1-4 unit and small multifamily, lending nationally. Loan size figures conflict across its own pages ($2M, $3M and $4M caps), so confirm current limits.

lenders.name: Red Tower Capital
lenders.footprint: SF Bay Area / California
lenders.programs: Bridge, Fix & flip, Ground-up construction, DSCR rental, Land acquisition
lenders.broker_program: Directory listings describe it as a partner for borrowers, mortgage brokers, real estate agents and investors. No written broker program, fee policy or signup page found.
lenders.address: One Sansome Street, Suite 1500, San Francisco, CA (another listing gives 111 Pine St., Suite 1715; confirm)
lenders.fit_notes: Direct San Francisco private lender (founded 2011) for small Bay Area bridge, construction and land deals up to about $3M, which fills the thin Bay Area segment. Terms come from directories, and the broker channel is implied rather than documented.

lenders.name: Broadshore Capital Partners
lenders.parent_or_aka: Formerly Guardian Life real estate debt affiliate; management buyout led by CEO Brad Howe, then reported acquired by Milhaus (2026)
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: Bridge, Ground-up construction, Special situations debt
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. 2025-2026 deals are announced as direct institutional loans; the trade items found do not name an arranging broker.
lenders.fit_notes: Closed a $53.2M floating-rate senior bridge loan on a new 137-unit San Diego (North Park) apartment property in June 2026 and makes $30M+ multifamily construction loans, so it suits large CA lease-up and construction take-out deals. Ownership changed in 2025-2026 (management buyout, then a reported Milhaus acquisition), so confirm the lending platform's status.

lenders.name: Lendmarq
lenders.parent_or_aka: Formerly Resfin Partners; Castlelake took majority ownership of Lendmarq and Eastview in April 2026
lenders.footprint: National (most active in FL, NJ, MD per recorded-mortgage data)
lenders.programs: Fix & flip, Bridge, Ground-up construction, DSCR rental
lenders.broker_program: A lender profile says Lendmarq offers white-label funding that keeps the broker's branding front and center. No wholesale rate sheet, fee cap or signup page found.
lenders.fit_notes: Broker-facing residential-investor lender with Castlelake backing since April 2026. California activity is not shown in the data found, so confirm CA licensing before sending deals.

lenders.name: Stratton Equities
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: Fix & flip, Ground-up construction (per brochure), Bridge, DSCR rental
lenders.broker_program: Private Lender Link lists a Broker Program and an Application Only program. No terms found.
lenders.fit_notes: National investor lender with a broker program. Its construction offering is unclear: an older brochure shows 85% LTC new construction, but a directory profile says 'NO Ground-Up Construction'. California lending not confirmed.

lenders.name: Conventus
lenders.footprint: California and national (residential investor)
lenders.programs: Bridge, Fix & flip, Construction (new construction per one listing), DSCR rental
lenders.broker_program: Directory listings route pricing and quote requests to a named Conventus sales contact by email. Conventus is an AAPL member and ranked #5 overall in Scotsman Guide's 2026 Top Private Lenders. No published broker agreement or fee cap found. No prepayment penalty on bridge loans; minimum FICO 660; non-owner-occupied only.
lenders.address: 115 Sansome Street, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94104 (another listing gives 111 Potrero Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94103)
lenders.fit_notes: High-volume Bay Area private lender (over $1B funded since 2015; #5 in Scotsman Guide's 2026 Top Private Lenders) for fast 1-4 unit and multifamily investor bridge loans up to about $5M. Listings disagree on ground-up construction (one says it does no land or ground-up construction), so confirm before sending construction deals.

lenders.name: Emerald Creek Capital
lenders.footprint: National (NY, CA, FL, TX named in 2021 release)
lenders.property_types: Multifamily, Mixed-use, Retail, Office, Industrial, Land
lenders.programs: Bridge
lenders.broker_program: No broker program page found. Trade items describe it as a direct bridge lender; whether it pays or protects broker fees is unconfirmed.
lenders.fit_notes: National direct commercial bridge lender. California activity found includes a $7.5M bridge loan in Banker's Hill, San Diego (2021). Public records show about $403M originated in the 12 months to December 2025 (average loan about $5M). The California evidence is older than 2024, so confirm current CA appetite.

lenders.name: Renovo Financial
lenders.footprint: Multi-state (most active TX, OH, NJ per recorded-mortgage data)
lenders.programs: Fix & flip, Bridge, Ground-up construction (spec homes, townhomes, small multifamily), DSCR rental, Multifamily
lenders.broker_program: Has a broker team per its listings (contact the lender for limits). AAPL member. No public broker fee policy found.
lenders.fit_notes: Ranked #3 overall in Scotsman Guide's 2026 Top Private Lenders (#4 in construction, #2 fix & flip, #3 multifamily) and builds spec homes and townhomes. California lending is not shown in the data found, so confirm CA eligibility before use.

lenders.name: Hearthstone
lenders.parent_or_aka: Hearthstone, Inc. / Hearthstone Residential; Five Point Holdings agreed to buy 75% of its land banking platform (2025); Blue Owl land banking partnership (Feb 2026)
lenders.footprint: National (CA, FL, GA and other housing markets)
lenders.programs: Land banking, Joint venture financing for homebuilders, Structured land / lot financing
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Works directly with homebuilders through land banking and JV structures.
lenders.fit_notes: California-based residential land banker (about $2.6B AUM) that has done structured financing of more than $80M for two San Diego-area communities. Fits entitled-land and lot deals for homebuilder clients. It is a land-banking and equity source rather than a broker-paying lender, and it is now majority-owned by Five Point.

lenders.name: Clearinghouse CDFI
lenders.footprint: National, focused on CA, NV, AZ, NM, TX and Indian Country
lenders.property_types: Churches, Charter schools, Affordable housing, Health care facilities, Mobile home parks, Nonprofit facilities
lenders.programs: Acquisition, Refinance, Construction, Renovation, Gap loans
lenders.broker_program: Describes itself as a direct lender. No broker program found.
lenders.fit_notes: California CDFI that lends for special-use property banks often decline: churches, charter schools, community facilities and mobile home parks (e.g. $11.17M mobile home park purchase out of bankruptcy). The $15M cap comes from a charter-school program page. No broker channel, so treat it as a referral source.

lenders.name: A&D Mortgage
lenders.footprint: National wholesale (dedicated California state page)
lenders.programs: DSCR rental, DSCR multifamily (5-8 units), DSCR mixed-use, Non-QM
lenders.max_leverage: Up to 80% CLTV (DSCR, CA page); 75% CLTV on 5-8 unit DSCR
lenders.broker_program: Wholesale-only: borrowers must apply through a licensed mortgage broker. The California page is titled 'Your wholesale lender in California'. Program matrices (DSCR, DSCR Multifamily, DSCR Mixed-Use) are published as PDFs on admortgage.com.
lenders.fit_notes: Wholesale-only DSCR lender with a California program and 5-8 unit and mixed-use DSCR matrices up to $3.5M. Gives fix & flip and construction borrowers a broker-paid long-term take-out. Min FICO 620-680 depending on program. No fix & flip or construction terms were found for A&D itself.

lenders.name: Avila Real Estate Capital
lenders.parent_or_aka: AREC; co-lender with Encore Capital Management on the 2023 Mountain House loan
lenders.footprint: National homebuilder lending (large California land book)
lenders.property_types: Residential land, Entitled lots, Master-planned communities, For-sale housing
lenders.programs: Land acquisition, Horizontal development, Vertical construction loans for homebuilders, Credit facilities
lenders.broker_program: No broker page found. Its California land loans are large, negotiated credit facilities. The round-1 notes say the 2023 Mountain House loan was arranged by PACT Capital; this was not re-verified here.
lenders.fit_notes: Bay Area (Corte Madera) private credit platform for homebuilder land acquisition, development and construction loans. It closed a $305M facility for more than 3,000 Mountain House lots (Sept 2026) and a $362M loan for over 5,500 lots with Encore (2023). Public records put the average loan at about $37M, so it fits only large land and lot deals.

lenders.name: Five Star Bank
lenders.footprint: Northern California (Sacramento Capital Region offices: Roseville, Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova, Sacramento/Natomas)
lenders.property_types: Commercial real estate, Multifamily, Affordable / tax-credit housing
lenders.programs: Ground-up construction, Renovation construction, Bridge, Interim loans, CRE term loans
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Its specialized lending page offers construction, bridge and interim loans with terms structured per project.
lenders.fit_notes: Sacramento-area community bank with a dedicated CRE and construction group (ground-up and renovation, plus bridge and interim loans) and experience with LIHTC, historic, brownfield and New Markets tax-credit capital stacks. Fits Central Valley and Capital Region construction deals. It is a bank, so expect relationship and recourse requirements, and broker compensation is unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Avidbank
lenders.footprint: SF Bay Area
lenders.property_types: SFR spec, Owner-occupied SFR, Condominiums, Subdivisions, Mixed-use, Commercial
lenders.programs: Land acquisition, Pre-development, Ground-up construction, Real estate bridge
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Construction lending is run by a dedicated group (EVP, Construction Lending) with in-house draw disbursement staff.
lenders.fit_notes: Bay Area bank whose construction group focuses on high-end and infill residential: spec homes, condos and subdivisions, plus land, pre-development and bridge loans. A good bank option for Bay Area for-sale and townhome construction. Broker compensation is unconfirmed, and loan sizes are not published.

lenders.name: Heritage Bank of Commerce
lenders.footprint: SF Bay Area / Northern California
lenders.property_types: SFR (owner-occupied and spec), Commercial real estate
lenders.programs: Ground-up construction, Investor CRE loans
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. It employs dedicated construction loan officers per 2025 job postings.
lenders.fit_notes: San Jose bank with a modest construction book (about $140.5M at Dec 2023) covering owner-occupied and spec SFR construction and investor CRE. A secondary Bay Area bank option; no terms are published and the broker channel is unconfirmed. Do not confuse it with the unrelated Heritage Bank in the Pacific Northwest.

lenders.name: Bay Area Capital Funding
lenders.footprint: SF Bay Area (San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose)
lenders.property_types: SFR 1-4, Multifamily, Office, Retail, Industrial, Mixed-use
lenders.programs: Bridge, Fix & flip / renovation, Asset-based hard money
lenders.broker_program: None found. No broker or wholesale page surfaced.
lenders.address: 790 Laurel Street, San Carlos, CA (per directory)
lenders.fit_notes: Small Peninsula asset-based lender for Bay Area residential and small commercial bridge loans. The only terms found come from one directory sample loan, so treat it as a lead to call, not a confirmed broker partner.

lenders.name: Mega Capital Funding
lenders.footprint: California wholesale lender (multi-state)
lenders.programs: DSCR rental, Elite DSCR (first-time investors allowed), Bank statement / Non-QM
lenders.max_leverage: 80% LTV purchase / R&T to $1.5M; 75% cash-out to $1.5M
lenders.broker_program: Wholesale lender with account-executive program sheets and a broker portal (mpowers.mcfunding.com). Brokers can send investor scenarios to Mega for review before submission. Minimum DSCR 0.75 on the core program.
lenders.fit_notes: California wholesale lender whose DSCR programs (up to $3M, DSCR down to 0.75, first-time investors on Elite DSCR) work as a broker-paid take-out for fix & flip and construction exits. The program sheets found are from 2023 or undated and conflict on max loan ($2.5M vs $3M); confirm the current matrix. Round-2 multifamily notes found no 5-8 unit product.

lenders.name: Century Housing Corporation
lenders.footprint: California
lenders.property_types: Affordable multifamily, Supportive housing, SRO rehabilitation
lenders.programs: Acquisition / bridge, Construction, Permanent, Emerging Developers Program, Inglewood Fund
lenders.broker_program: No broker program; Century lends directly to affordable housing developers.
lenders.licenses: Nonprofit CDFI (US Treasury CDFI Fund award, Feb 2025); rated AA by Fitch and S&P (reaffirmed Aug 2026)
lenders.fit_notes: California's AA-rated affordable housing CDFI. It expanded construction lending in 2024-2025 when banks pulled back, including loans that bridge state rehab funds paid only after completion. Fits deed-restricted affordable and supportive housing construction and acquisition. Mission-driven and direct, so treat it as a referral lender.

lenders.name: EverTrust Bank
lenders.footprint: California (Southern California branches incl. City of Industry, Alhambra, Irvine)
lenders.programs: Ground-up construction, Bridge, CRE acquisition, Refinance
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. The bank's CRE pages offer acquisition, refinance, bridge and construction financing for residential and commercial property.
lenders.address: City of Industry, CA (per DFPI record)
lenders.fit_notes: Southern California bank that focuses on Chinese-American businesses and offers CRE construction and bridge loans on apartments, retail, office and residential, the same niche as Cathay, Preferred and RBB (all in the directory). Terms are unpublished and the broker channel is unconfirmed.

lenders.name: California Hard Money Direct
lenders.footprint: California statewide (excludes rural locations)
lenders.programs: Bridge, Commercial hard money, Refinance of completed construction
lenders.broker_program: Listing services say it has served borrowers and brokers for about 10 years. No written broker agreement or fee policy found.
lenders.fit_notes: Statewide California hard money lender for commercial, industrial and residential investor bridge loans from $50K to $20M. It states it does NOT lend on vacant land, land development or ground-up construction and does not fund rehab, so use it only for bridge and refinance deals. Terms come from directories.

excluded.name: Finance of America Commercial (FACo Lending)
excluded.reason: Operating assets sold to Roc360 (Roc Capital, already in the directory). The sale closed March 14, 2023, and Finance of America no longer originates business-purpose investor loans. Route these deals to Roc Capital.

excluded.name: JCR Capital
excluded.reason: Subsidiary of Walker & Dunlop, which is already in the directory. The only California deals found are from 2013 (mezz on a 16-property portfolio, 12 in CA; land JV equity). No 2025-2026 lending found. Reach it through Walker & Dunlop.

excluded.name: Hard Money First (hardmoneyfirst.com)
excluded.reason: Marketing site run by Source Capital (San Diego), which is already in the directory. Same lender: direct hard money, 8.99%-11.99% first position, up to 65% LTV, licensed CA/TX/CO/MN/AZ.

excluded.name: Six Peak Capital
excluded.reason: Los Angeles developer and borrower, not a lender: it received construction loans from East West Bank (arranged by WAY Capital) and a $31.3M loan arranged by Priority Capital Advisory.

excluded.name: Ocean West Capital Partners
excluded.reason: El Segundo real estate investor and operator (office, industrial, multifamily acquisitions). No 2025-2026 lending, mezzanine or preferred equity program found.

excluded.name: Valley Republic Bank (Bakersfield)
excluded.reason: Merged into Tri Counties Bank (TriCo Bancshares, Chico) on March 25, 2022; no longer a separate lender.

not_researched.name: Insula Capital Group
not_researched.note: National hard money lender (non-owner-occupied residential and commercial purchase/rehab loans). One search found no loan sizes, broker terms or CA-specific data, plus old negative forum reviews.

not_researched.name: Fort Knox Capital
not_researched.note: AAPL directory lists it as a Glendale, CA private lender (bridge, rehab, construction, long-term; member contact David Yee). No program terms or broker policy found.

not_researched.name: Sherman Bridge Lending
not_researched.note: Fix & flip lender that launched an investor loan marketplace in 2023. No current broker terms or California coverage found in one search.

not_researched.name: Unitas Funding
not_researched.note: Jacksonville, FL fix & flip and new construction lender (#20 in Scotsman Guide's 2026 Top Private Lenders). Listed as lending in 42 states but most active in NJ/OH/FL; described as a direct lender. California and broker channel not confirmed.

not_researched.name: River City Bank (Sacramento)
not_researched.note: Large Sacramento CRE bank (about $4.0B non-owner-occupied CRE at YE2025) but only about $25.8M in construction and land loans, so it is a CRE term lender more than a construction lender. Better suited to the Bank / SBA community bank CRE segment; not added here.

not_researched.name: CA DRE Multi-Lender / Threshold Brokers list
not_researched.note: DRE public list of private money threshold brokers (https://secure.dre.ca.gov/PublicASP/MultiLenderThresholdBrokers.asp). A good discovery source for California trust-deed lenders and funds; not mined (search cap).

not_researched.name: California Bank & Trust (Zions)
not_researched.note: Large California bank (over $12B assets, 80+ branches). One search found no current construction program or 2025-2026 CA construction deal (a $33M Silicon Valley office acquisition loan was found).

not_researched.name: DLP Lending
not_researched.note: DLP Real Estate Capital's lending arm (fix & flip, new construction, multifamily bridge; 'Elite Partner' model). California coverage and broker terms not found.

not_researched.name: Excelerate Capital
not_researched.note: Orange County (Newport Beach / Irvine) Non-QM wholesale lender holding a California residential mortgage license; DSCR listed as a keyword. No program terms found.

not_researched.name: June Point Lending
not_researched.note: Reported launching DSCR loans in California (HousingWire). Not researched.

not_researched.name: Tri Counties Bank (TriCo Bancshares)
not_researched.note: Chico-based bank, about $10B in assets, and the largest community bank in Kern County after the Valley Republic merger. It planned to expand construction lending; no current construction program terms found.

not_researched.name: Oaktree Funding Corp. / EMM Loans
not_researched.note: Oaktree Funding 'Investor Advantage' DSCR matrix (effective Dec 2022: $150K-$3M, min FICO 680) is hosted on emmloans.com, suggesting the program now runs under EMM Loans. Current status not verified.

not_researched.name: Allied Mortgage Group (wholesale DSCR)
not_researched.note: Published a March 2026 wholesale DSCR product matrix (wholesale.alliedmg.com). California eligibility not checked.

not_researched.name: JCAP Private Lending
not_researched.note: Has a Private Lender Link profile; not researched.

not_researched.name: Hard Money Lenders California (Newport Beach)
not_researched.note: Directory lists bridge, fix & flip, renovation, commercial and construction programs; not researched.

not_researched.name: Central Lending
not_researched.note: Florida direct lender with a 'VIP Broker Program'; ground-up loans need an appraisal and a $300 budget review fee; operates in most states. California not confirmed.

not_researched.name: TLOA Capital LLC; Nexus Commercial Finance; TVC Funding; Capital Funding Financial; Blue Mountain Capital; Propel Real Estate Capital; Sphinx Capital
not_researched.note: AAPL or directory listings with construction or bridge products and some broker-partner language. Location and California lending not checked.

not_researched.name: Eastview Investment Partners
not_researched.note: Sister lender to Lendmarq (Castlelake majority owner since April 2026). Not researched.

not_researched.name: Evangelical Christian Credit Union (ECCU, Brea) and other church lenders
not_researched.note: Southern California church and ministry lender with a loan participation program. One search found no current loan sizes or broker policy.

not_researched.name: Pacific City Funding; Bond Street Mortgage; RGC Capital
not_researched.note: Appeared in search results as fix & flip, new construction or bridge lenders; identity and California lending not verified.
